title: A book to build authority
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What would you write a book about, if you had to prove your authority?

Jose introduced the book to those who had not yet got it. He said the author is a publisher who works with entrepreneurs and business people, and that what the firm is about is basically personal branding: magnifying your presence in the business world and leaving a legacy by writing a book about what you have done.
He said that a person who wrote a book about a field becomes an authority in that space, and then markets the book through interviews and outlets worldwide.

A student said it is an easy read, and that it is interesting to think about what you can do with the authority you create: once it is set up, you can continue down a path and become more and more successful.

Jose said there will be a lot of action items, things we need to act on and get done, because if you do not do it you will not take advantage of what you are learning. A student said: there are action items and takeaways in each chapter.
What would you do with authority if you had it?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the field you want to be known in.
Write what a book from you would be about.
Write one action you will take from each chapter.
Write what you would do with the authority.

check.q: What did Jose say the author's firm is basically about?
What did a student say about the book?
What did Jose say there will be in the calls?

recap: A book builds authority. Choose your field. Act on each chapter.
